sources.title: MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA Download: 4-Step Audio-Video Generation
sources.snippet: Start from the official MiniMax H3 open-weights workflow, insert the Turbo LoRA between the model loader and the sampler, and replace the sampler with the MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler (4-step) with scheduler set to simple. A ready-made text-to-video workflow is bundled in the repo (minimax_h3_t2v_turbo.json) and in the node repo's example workflows.
